name: Causal Crypto Spot Daily Donchian Breakout (Hard ATR Stop)
stop_loss_rule: Mandatory hard 2.5x ATR trailing stop on daily close
rule_description: Enter long spot BTCUSDT/ETHUSDT on daily close above 20-day Donchian high when above 100-day SMA; exit on 10-day Donchian low or mandatory hard 2.5x ATR protective stop; avoids sub-4H taker churn, zero grid, zero martingale.
raw_text: Open public specification for causal spot crypto trend following on D1 bars (frame >= 4H). Uses limit/maker-aware execution and mandatory hard 2.5x ATR stop loss. Strictly avoids grid, avoids martingale, never averages down.
